events.name: Columbus River Dragons vs. Blue Ridge Bobcats
events.info: COLUMBUS RIVER DRAGONS 2026-2027 HOCKEY SEASON Ages 3 and up Admission tickets are required Individual Game Tickets can be purchased via ticketmaster.com or at the Columbus Civic Center Box Office Monday through Friday 10 AM - 6 PM Box Office hours are Monday through Friday 10 AM - 6 PM Game tickets can be purchased at the Box Office on Game Days as well. Box Office Hours for Saturday game days begin at 1:00 PM Contact the Columbus River Dragons for Season tickets, group tickets or for certain ticket offers at 706-507-4625 A clear bag policy is enforced at the Columbus Civic Center. Please visit https://www.columbusga.gov/civiccenter-2/Plan-Your-Visit/Clear-Bag-Policy for detailed information Columbus Civic Center is a cashless and ticketless venue We accept VISA, Mastercard and Discover Tickets will be delivered electronically via email or text

venues.name: Columbus Civic Center

address.line1: 400 4th Street (Also Known As Victory Dr, US 280)

boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: General Event Information: 706-653-4460 Civic Center Main Number: 706-653-4482 Box Office Fax: 706-225-4923
boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Located in the front of the Columbus Civic Center. Monday-Friday: 10:00am - 5:00pm
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Located at the first window on the left in the lobby. Opens 1 hour before event start time. PLEASE BRING A PICTURE ID, THE ACTUAL CREDIT CARD USED TO PURCHASE THE TICKETS, AND YOUR ORDER NUMBER.

venues.parkingDetail: The Civic Center has over 3500 spaces for all its events. The most convenient way to access the Civic Center parking lot is on the north side of the building from Veteran's Parkway and Victory Drive.

generalInfo.generalRule: No Smoking (Smoke Free Venue) No Bags No Banners No Coolers No Weapons No Laser Pointers No Book Bags or Containers No Outside Food or Beverages may be brought in
generalInfo.childRule: Unless otherwise specified, Children 3 & older require a ticket.
